title: Loops Inside Loops
brief:
Four flags, evenly spaced four tiles apart. You could write one loop of sixteen steps — but the structure of the level is really "four tiles, four times".

A loop body can contain another loop:

for flag in range(4):
    for step in range(4):
        right()

The inner loop runs all the way through on every single pass of the outer one. Trace it on paper before you run it: how many right() calls happen in total?
